theorem profile_derivative_bound {a : ℝ} (ha : 1 < a) (n : ℕ) {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 ≤ z) :
    |iteratedDerivWithin n (profile a) (Ici 0) z| ≤
      |(Real.Gamma a)⁻¹ * derivativeCoeff a n| * Real.Gamma (a + (n : ℝ))
